erin (docs): Quick PR to refresh a few SDK snippets: streaming (async iterator examples), cursor pagination (brief), and a tiny retry/backoff example. Also fixing a dead internal link to the retry guidance. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/999

kai (eng): Thanks  I'll review Python + TS. Are these purely example edits?

mohit (sdk): I'll take Go. Naming convention: stream_generate for Python, streamGenerate for TS/Go?

erin (docs): Yes, keep idiomatic names by language. No runtime changes intended. I added a minimal CI harness in the PR description that runs each example for one iteration to catch async regressions. Snippets pasted below for quick eyeballs.

erin (docs): ```python
# python: streaming + retry (one iteration for CI)
from redwood import Client
import asyncio
client = Client()
async def single():
    async for ch in client.stream_generate("Short summary please", max_tokens=60, retry_policy={"backoff":"exponential","max_retries":2}):
        print(ch.text)
        break
asyncio.run(single())
```

erin (docs): ```ts
// typescript: streaming minimal
const s = client.streamGenerate({ prompt: 'Short summary please', maxTokens: 60 });
for await (const chunk of s) { console.log(chunk.text); break }
// note: very short responses may be coalesced by the transport
```

erin (docs): ```go
// go: basic cursor pagination example
ctx := context.Background()
it := client.ListEmbeddings(ctx, &redwood.ListEmbeddingsRequest{PageSize: 25})
if it.Next() { _ = it.Item() }
if err := it.Err(); err != nil { /* report */ }
// next_cursor will be empty at EOF
```
